description:
In a poor rural village, there was a nameless boy who led a poor life without even knowing his parents.

The conflict between the Moorim people who are drunk with power has turned the village into a battlefield, and the boy who is dying alone in the burnt out village is saved by a mysterious old man.

No Go-Su, disillusioned with the previously corrupted Moorim, turned his back on the strong man, and asks him to help the weak as a representative of the shabby mark "Hyeopdo mark".

Years pass by and the grown-up boy gets the name "Mu-Yeong," because he has no connection in the world, and grows up as a representative of Hyeopdo. However, unlike the master who insists on doing things for the suffering people without asking for anything in return, his only interest is to earn money and live on a remote island... Will he be able to be reborn as a 'strong gangster' according to his master's wishes? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*
